title: Refined Fuels Account Credit Limits, Accepted Payment Channels and Statement Delivery
content:
The catalogue for Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts fixes for each programme the unpaid balance the cooperative will carry, the ways the member may pay, whether grain settlement proceeds may be credited onto the account, and how the energy statement reaches the member.

| Programme | Balance carried, USD | Payment channels accepted | Grain settlement proceeds accepted | Statement reaches the member by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Will-Call Propane Account | 2500.00 | cheque, bank transfer, card | no | mailed statement |
| Keep-Full Automatic Delivery Account | 5000.00 | cheque, bank transfer, card, grain settlement transfer | yes | mailed statement |
| Budget Payment Plan Account | 6000.00 | cheque, bank transfer, level plan draft, card, grain settlement transfer | yes | emailed statement |
| Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account | 10000.00 | cheque, bank transfer, level plan draft, card, grain settlement transfer | yes | emailed statement |
| Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account | 40000.00 | cheque, bank transfer, grain settlement transfer | yes | member portal and email |
| Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Account | 60000.00 | cheque, bank transfer, grain settlement transfer | yes | member portal and email |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The balance the cooperative will carry rises steadily with the programme, from 2500.00 USD on the Will-Call Propane Account through 5000.00, 6000.00 and 10000.00 USD on the three middle propane programmes to 40000.00 USD on the Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account and 60000.00 USD on the Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Account.
2. The Will-Call Propane Account is the only programme in the catalogue that does not accept grain settlement proceeds onto the account; on every other programme the transfer is open.
3. The level plan draft is accepted only on the Budget Payment Plan and Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Accounts, the two programmes on which a level monthly plan is carried. The card channel is not accepted on the Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery or Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Accounts.
4. Statements are mailed on the two entry propane programmes, emailed on the Budget Payment Plan and Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Accounts, and carried on the member portal as well as by email on the two refined fuels programmes.
